title: Past the teacher
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Wait while Dask looks this way.
# Then cross up.
hints: You must wait as long as Dask looks left. Use a `while` loop.
Ask with `while` which way `dask.facing` is, and wait under it.
Dask looks away when the loop stops. Move up two times.
intro: Dask patrols the long corridor here. We cannot guess when to move. We must wait while he looks this way.
outro: We did it! We waited until it was safe.
learned: Now you know how to wait with a `while` repeat, which programmers call a loop.
